evals.prompt:
Use $web-design-guidelines. Audit this UI snippet and report concise, actionable findings with severity and a suggested fix. Do not edit files: ```html
Save
``` Focus on semantics, keyboard/focus behavior, accessible naming, and interaction states.
evals.expected_output: A concise UI audit with actionable findings covering semantic controls, accessible naming, keyboard/focus behavior, and interaction states.
expectations: The response flags the clickable div and recommends a semantic button or equivalent keyboard-accessible control.
The response flags the unlabeled search input and recommends an accessible label or equivalent name.
The response covers keyboard or focus behavior.
The findings are actionable and prioritized rather than merely describing the markup.
